title: The Midnight Express
summary: A ghost train that runs between the Necropoli.

claims.text: The Midnight Express stops at stations in many great cities and at obscure places where stations once stood; its purpose and crew are a mystery, though it may first have been run by Ferrymen to guide souls to Stygia.
Hierarchy, Renegades and Heretics all ride it, and it can even cross oceans.

At each stop only one car can be boarded, the train lingers about three minutes, and its cars come from many periods, most without a covered walkway between them, so crossing means a moment exposed to the Tempest.
